english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something whose settings or position can be adjusted.

examples.english: The armrests on this office chair are adjustable, so you can set them higher or lower.
examples.traditional: 呢張電腦椅個扶手係可以調校嘅，你坐高坐低都得。
